title: On a fractional stochastic heat equation arising from the disordered pinning model
summary: We study the mild Skorohod solution to the following fractional stochastic heat equation on $\mathbb{R}$: \begin{equation} \begin{cases} \partial_t u(t,x)=-(-Δ)^{ρ/2} u(t,x) +βu(t,x)δ_0(x)ξ(t),\\ u(0,\cdot)=u_0(x), \end{cases} \end{equation} where $-(-Δ)^{ρ/2}$ with $ρ\in(0,2]$ is the fractional Laplacian and $ξ$ is a Gaussian noise with covariance $\mathbb{E}[ξ(t) ξ(s)]=|t-s|^{2H-2}$ for $H\in(\frac12, 1]$.
